objective: P9 cannot bypass approval of its PRD and applicable technical design prerequisites.
scenario: The project state marks P9 complete and the build plan/demo plan are approved, but P7 and P8 are absent and the PRD/technical design remain drafts.
expected_behaviors: Block P9 completion until P7 and P8 are complete and the PRD and applicable technical design are approved.
Keep task readiness separate from owner authorization to execute.
prohibited_behaviors: Treat an approved build plan and demo plan as sufficient to bypass upstream product and design approval.
